status.evidence: state law AB 1482, the California Tenant Protection Act of 2019 , may regulate the rent amount in buildings that are older than 15 years old.
status.note: Presented as current law, with a current-year page date and no repeal noted.

coverage.evidence: -Units that were constructed within the last 15 years (this applies on a rolling basis – i.e.. a unit constructed on January 1, 2006 is not covered as of January, 1 2020, but is covered on and after January 1, 2021).
coverage.note: The 15-year exemption is supported. The document says a two-unit property is exempt if the second unit was occupied by an owner for the entire tenancy, which is only loosely a 'max 2 units' value. The card omits the owner-occupancy condition.

citation.note: The document cites 1947.12(d)(5)(B)(i) for the single-family exemption notice, not the rent cap itself. It names AB 1482 and the Tenant Protection Act, but does not cite § 1947.12 for the cap.
